div.head: II Cn 45.1
div.ab: Gyf freoman freolsdæge wyrce, þonne gebete þæt mid his halsfange, ⁊ huru wið God bete hit georne, swa swa man him tæce.
Gif freoman freolsdage wyrce, þonne gebete þæt mid his halsfange, ⁊ huru wið Godd bete hit georne, swa swa him man tæce.
Si liber festis diebus operetur, emendet hoc secundum suum hálsfang, et saltem erga Deum emendet sedulo, sicut edocebitur.
Be haligdæiges freolse. Gyf frigman freolsdæge wyrce, ðonne gebete he þæt mid his healsfange, ⁊ huru wið God bete hit georne, swa swa him man tæce.

Concerning the Sunday festival. If a freeman works during a church festival, he shall make amends for doing so by the payment of his healsfang, and especially he shall zealously make amends to God, according to the directions given him.
(Von Festtagsfeier. B) Wenn ein Freier am Feiertage arbeitet, dann büsse er das mit seinem Halsfang; und namentlich kirchlich büsse er es ernstlich, wie ihm vorgeschrieben werden wird.
(Of keeping feast-days. B) If a free man works on a feast-day, then let him pay compensation for it with his healsfang; and above all let him atone for it eagerly before God, as he is instructed.
